title: Puppy Obedience Training for Good Boys (F4TM)
description:
I always wanted a puppy. A cute, playful puppy with no thoughts except making me happy. Let me show you how enjoyable it can be. I know deep down you’ve always wanted to be a puppy, too.
This is a relaxing and sensual domination hypnosis session that will put you into the correct headspace to allow you to let go of everything else, and become a happy, mindless, obedient puppy for me.
I’ll take all your stress away, and make you mine as your owner and Master. I’ll teach you instant obedience to my unique clicker command triggers, that I created just for you. Mindless obedience has never felt so good.
author: Goddess Nichole
